snippet.text: const rows = await db.query(`SELECT * FROM claims WHERE claimant ILIKE '%${q}%'`);

message.text:
A value from the request reaches the text of a SQL statement, so whoever sends the request can
rewrite the statement: read other rows, change them or drop the table.

Pass the value as a bound parameter, beside the statement text and never inside it, or build the
statement with a tag that binds its substitutions (`sql`, `Prisma.sql`, `prisma.$queryRaw`) —
never by concatenation or an untagged template literal.
